description: Every start year 2015-2024 (Connecticut only 2015-2019: Census replaced its counties with planning regions): the county permit model refitted on data through that year only, forecasting 1-5 years ahead (to 2025), summed to states and compared with actual permits and with two simple rules (repeat last year; repeat the last five years' average). Conditions held at start-year values. Built by agents/src/backtest.rs.
